title: A Conversation With Ari Emanuel About Entertainment and AI
author: Ben Thompson
description: A conversation with Hollywood super-agent Ari Emanuel about his memoir, the impact of AI on Hollywood, and the power of a phone call.
summary: Listen to this post: Good morning, This week’s Stratechery Interview ended up not being an Interview, but rather a conversation with Hollywood super-agent Ari Emanuel . Emanuel is the Executive Chairman of WME Group , Executive Chair and CEO of TKO Group Holdings (the owner of UFC and WWE), and Founder of MARI , a live events and experiences company.
takeaways: AE: I loved your point of view, and explain a little bit more to me because I love your thinking — that on a SaaS model, the only one, based on my understanding, based on your model right now, that’s got it right, OpenAI should have gone to advertising as opposed to charging, Muse has it right.

The occasion for this conversation née interview was the recent publication of Emanuel’s memoir, Roll the Calls , a reference to Emanuel’s relentless daily phone call routine; I got on Emanuel’s roll for the first time a couple of years ago, and quickly learned that when Emanuel wants something he gets it.
So you’re matching these two things together, and that’s how advertising basically works at scale, and it’s all these vector databases, all these sorts of things.
